title: image-choice surface: schema and validator
goal: An image-choice payload is accepted or rejected exactly by its schema
acceptance: Owner idea 2026-11-26 in chat: "in future I will be able to recover a recipe or a hobo place, say it was without image, I will be able to put it in chat and tell to use that, or to find some on the web, propose (using genUI?) and save the accepted." The proposal is a bricks surface both NERV and the projects can use (nerv:F-143).

Surface kind image-choice: title, prompt, 1 to 12 candidates {id, imageUrl, alt (required), source, licence, author, sourceUrl shown as text}, optional allowNone; added to REGISTERED_COMPONENTS and Surface

imageUrl is accepted only when it matches a pattern the consumer passes (NERV: same-origin /api/… paths; default: relative paths only), so no third-party image is loaded by the card; hostile payloads (javascript:, data: other than image/, oversize text, duplicate ids) rejected in surface.spec.ts
privacy: Invented candidates and placeholder images generated in the test; no third-party image URLs in fixtures.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one more schema next to recipe-card's photo pattern, plus hostile cases. Not a measurement.
